```sh
kafka profiles
```

List the named connection profiles configured under cli.profiles

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Lists all configured profiles and marks the active one; credential fields are redacted.

## Examples

```sh
kafka profiles
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "active": null,
  "profiles": {}
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
